## Documentation

A service message about a new forum topic created in the chat.


### Parameters

- **`id`** (`int`)
  Id of the topic

- **`title`** (`str`)
  Name of the topic.

- **`icon_color`** (`int`)
  Color of the topic icon in decimal format.

- **`custom_emoji_id`** (`int`, *optional*)
  Unique identifier of the custom emoji shown as the topic icon.
